home.seo_title: Lost and found pets in Slovenia · Najdimo
home.seo_description: Lost or found a dog or cat? Report it for free. Najdimo looks for matches by chip and description and alerts people nearby.
home.hero_title: Lost pet? Let's bring them home together.
home.hero_lede: Report a lost or found pet. We look for possible matches and alert people nearby. For free.
home.hero_alt: A brown and white long-haired dog with one ear raised
home.hero_cat_alt: A tabby cat with a blue collar and tag sitting on stairs
home.near_empty_body: That is good news. Turn on alerts and we will let you know if someone nearby is missing a pet.
home.near_error: We cannot load the reports right now.
home.how_1_body: Reporting a lost pet takes a few minutes. A found animal takes under a minute, with no account.
home.how_2_body: We compare chip numbers, areas, times and descriptions, and tell you when we find a possible match.
home.how_3_body: You message each other in the app. Phone numbers and exact addresses stay hidden.
home.safe_body: When a pet goes missing, some people try to take advantage. That is why your details stay with you.
home.safe_1: Your phone number is never public.
home.safe_2: We only show an approximate area, never an address.
home.safe_3: Conversations happen in the app, with a clear warning about scams.
home.shelters_body: Publish found animals quickly and we compare them with every lost-pet report. For shelters and municipalities everything is free, forever.
home.cta_title: Report a lost or found pet.
